description: This file defines the ContentTypeHandler class, which manages different content types by their file extensions and determines the appropriate content type for a given node based on its path or name.

classes.name: ContentTypeHandler
classes.description: Handles the registration and lookup of content types based on file extensions and content nodes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the handler with an array of ContentType objects, reversing their order for precedence.

methods.name: getContentExtensions
methods.description: Retrieves all unique file extensions associated with the registered content types.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Determines and returns the content type for a given content node based on its file extension, or throws an exception if none match.
